title: Semantic Audio Taxonomy & Availability Resolver

future_start_resolution: freshly verify then-current AIOC and application heads and re-read completed AAI-01..04 evidence
define the provider-neutral semantic audio taxonomy over existing AAI-02 AudioIntent, asset, cue and source identities without rewriting provider-native or canonical identities
define explicit availability evidence states and a deterministic resolver that fails closed for unknown, denied, unavailable or incompatible evidence
define how manual references, silent cues, unresolved cues and AAI-04 nonblocking playback outcomes interact with resolver output without silently choosing a provider asset
define provenance, rights and capability checks independently so semantic compatibility never grants play rights or provider capability
keep provider-specific live adapters, provider authentication, live catalogs and acquisition as later AAI-06 authority
preserve World/Event/Scene/Combat/Action/Visibility/D29 owners and prohibit resolver output from becoming gameplay truth
determine whether AAI-05 requires durable persistence and reserve migration 0022 only if a separately demonstrated schema delta actually requires it
resolve exact AAI-05 deliverables, focused tests/verifier, predecessor regressions and exact-head self-hosted acceptance gate before creating an implementation branch
selection_contract.authority_rule: Selection authorizes planning resolution only. It does not authorize an implementation branch, semantic resolver code, provider authentication/live catalogs/provider calls, provider-specific adapters, acquisition/download/copying, scraping, payment, migration 0022, tester distribution, release or deployment.
selection_contract.provider_rule: Semantic planning must keep semantic compatibility, AAI-02 rights evidence and AAI-03 capability evidence independent. Unknown, denied, unavailable or unsupported evidence remains fail closed and no resolver may bypass provider terms or rights boundaries.
selection_contract.owner_rule: Semantic audio taxonomy and availability state remain presentation/support data only and cannot create or replace canonical World, Event, Scene, Combat, Action, Visibility or other gameplay truth.

preserved_boundaries: AAI-01..04 are completed_verified with no further implementation authority
AAI-05 is selected_not_started with no implementation branch or implementation authority
AAI-02 provider/source/asset/intent/cue/soundscape/mix identities and rights evidence remain canonical inputs
AAI-03 adapter capability negotiation remains evidence-driven and cannot override AAI-02 rights
AAI-04 playback/layer/mixer behavior remains provider-neutral and cannot be widened by selection
audio intent remains separate from provider identity and provider asset/reference identity
no provider/catalog is canonical and unsupported/unknown capability remains explicit and fail closed
commercial provider audio remains controlled/referenced rather than copied absent explicit license
AAI-06 provider-specific live adapters remain unauthorized
migration 0022 remains unreserved until a separately demonstrated durable schema delta requires it
no provider acquisition/download/authentication/live catalog/payment, tester distribution, release/deployment or real-money activation is authorized by selection
next_action: Selection only. On the next owner Continue, freshly verify then-current AIOC/application heads, re-read AAI-01..04 completed evidence plus the AAI program/backlog and this selection contract, resolve the exact provider-neutral semantic taxonomy/availability, persistence and validation contract, and only then governed-start AAI-05. Until then do not create an implementation branch or reserve migration 0022.
